system_instructions.task_description: I am going to provide you with a Style Guide and 7 example video scripts about fictional but hyper-realistic military conflict scenarios. Your task is to create ONE NEW imaginary scenario with exactly the same tone, technical precision, and high-stakes adrenaline.
constraints: Do not copy the example scenarios.
Create a completely new imaginary military/tactical scenario.
Match the militaristic, authoritative, and cinematic tone exactly.
The length must be between 10,000 and 15,000 characters (comprehensive depth).
Provide the output in this format: 1. Video Idea, 2. Video Title (Military-Clickbait style), 3. Full Script.
system_instructions.critical_instruction: Use precise military terminology (weapon systems, tactical acronyms, radar jargon). The title must be aggressive and the script must be a complete, minute-by-minute escalation.

style_guide.Tone of Voice: Intense, cinematic, militaristic, and high-adrenaline. Combines technical military precision with dramatic battlefield narration. Confident and authoritative with escalating urgency throughout.
style_guide.Narrative Structure: Immediate kinetic incident → rapid tactical escalation → reveal of coordinated enemy strategy → layered multi-domain threat (surface, air, subsurface, electronic) → brink-of-disaster climax → high-risk special forces intervention → partial resolution with lingering geopolitical consequences.
style_guide.Pacing: Fast and relentless. Short bursts of action followed by rapid technical explanation. Escalation cycles every few paragraphs. Countdown elements compress time to intensify climax.
style_guide.Hook Style: Precise timestamp opening. Sudden violent trigger event within first lines. Immediate sensory chaos. Presents the attack as a premeditated trap.
style_guide.Sentence Style: Compact action sentences mixed with dense military terminology. Heavy use of specific system names (AEGIS, CIWS, Mach speeds). Frequent use of 'At the same time...', 'Simultaneously...'.
style_guide.Visual Cue Prompts: Radar screens flashing, tactical data overlays, missile container lids opening, drone swarms, sonar waveforms, night-vision footage, thermal imaging.
style_guide.Emotional Tone: Adrenaline-driven, suspenseful, claustrophobic during combat. Ends with unresolved unease rather than triumph.
style_guide.Point of View: Third-person omniscient battlefield narrator with access to tactical systems and command centers.
style_guide.Language Style: Highly technical military vocabulary (acronyms, platforms). Structured like a defense-analysis documentary fused with action thriller.
style_guide.Audience Addressing Style: Direct engagement to provoke opinion ('What would you do?'). Ends with a warning about future global conflict.
